title: QuPath Hepatocyte Extension: run the hepatocyte-app liver segmentation model on QuPath annotations
description:
A QuPath 0.6+ extension that packages the hepatocyte-app deep-learning liver H&E segmentation workflow as one-click menu entries under Extensions → Hepatocyte.

Menu items: (1) import slides from a folder into the project and set them to brightfield H&E; (2) run the TorchScript segmentation model on the selected area annotation(s). Inference runs outside QuPath: the extension writes a request JSON, calls the repo's Python bridge (hepatocyte_qupath_inference.py) in the project's venv, and imports the returned GeoJSON polygons back as classified QuPath annotations with per-class cell-count measurements and an optional Excel report.

The model emits five morphological classes (Balloon dystrophy, Mesenchymal, Non-nuclear, Normal, Steatosis). It produces a deep-learning prediction that must be verified visually; no clinical grade or score (NAS/SAF/fibrosis) is derived.

Requires a local checkout of hepatocyte-app with its Python venv and the TorchScript model checkpoint (🔒 available on request); paths are configured in the extension's Settings dialog.

Scope: research and education only.
notes: Packaging + distribution layer for the hepatocyte-app QuPath workflow. The model runs outside QuPath via the repo's Python bridge; the TorchScript checkpoint is available on request. Research and education only.
